svg.aria-label: How evidence-layer works, in four phases: gather evidence at the commit before the review is written, write the review by keeping the addressed artifact blocks, verify claims, the sealed run and the Access Receipt when the agent stops and again in CI, and count findings, gate decisions and misses over time in the journal.
